_comment: Caps on structural-debt signals under dblift/, consumed by scripts/check_debt_ratchet.py. Counts must stay flat or shrink by default. A narrowly scoped compatibility-boundary exception may raise a cap only when the same change records its measured delta and compatibility rationale in _policy. Freed headroom must not be reused: lower the cap in the same pull request that lowers the count.
_policy: Initial measurement on develop fdfe3be (2026-09-21); tightened on develop 1f2a12e after unreachable code was removed; tightened again after the post-commit table probe was removed from the migration engine. Comment-only lines are never counted. function_level_imports: package imports below module level. any_annotations: non-import lines using Any in a type. dynamic_attribute_access: lines calling getattr/hasattr. broad_excepts: 'except Exception' handlers. large_files: modules over 800 lines. process_references: lines naming an internal tracking identifier (epic/story numbers, ticket ids); held at 0. any_annotations raised by 1 for SqlGeneratorProtocol.generate_schema_script(options: Optional[Any]): its real type, ScriptOptions, lives in the generator package that dblift/db must not import, and object would make BaseSqlGenerator fail the Protocol. SQL Server nullable rendering adds two optional metadata reads (expected_data_type and data_type_diff) so older extension diff objects safely decline without a type. SQL Server type rendering adds three optional-read lines for nullable_diff, expected_nullable and expected_column.nullable; both generator diff shapes must be supported, and absent metadata must decline rather than guess. Oracle identity capture implements the existing enhance_columns Any-typed hook (+1 annotation line), and rendering reads optional identity_generation (+1) for legacy column compatibility.
